title: Machine-learning national wetland prediction, New Zealand, 2025
sourceName: Remote Sensing (MDPI), volume 17, issue 15, article 2626, figure 8
credit: Md. Saiful Islam Khan, Maria C. Vega-Corredor and Matthew D. Wilson (2025), Remote Sensing 17(15), 2626, Figure 8, CC BY 4.0
altText: National modelled wetland distribution compared with an existing New Zealand land-cover dataset and potential wetland extent.
caption: University of Canterbury researchers' 2025 national wetland prediction, comparing machine-learning output with mapped wetland datasets. This is actual New Zealand ML geospatial work, not an output from the LUCAS programme.
context: Figure 8 from Khan, Vega-Corredor and Wilson (2025), showing (a) national predictions of wetlands by a histogram gradient boosting model, (b) the LCDBv5 wetland layer and (c) potential wetland area. The study was published 29 July 2025. It must not be described as a LUCAS 2020 result.
